document.title: Injury brief · Sunday, October 25
opening: Late changes for the 7:00 and 7:30 tips: Ausar Thompson and Jose Alvarado are now Out, VJ Edgecombe is newly Questionable, Kawhi Leonard is out for Toronto, and Anthony Black is cleared. DraftKings cut Bane to 18.5 and Bona to 5.5 points, which makes those the two overs worth a look.
7 games, 46 players listed. CourtAI's splits are from last season, so every case is checked against this season's games; where they disagree, this season wins. LAL @ UTA and IND @ BKN have tipped.

New since 4:30 (report checked at 6:30 PM ET): Ausar Thompson (DET) Out, Jose Alvarado (NYK) Out, VJ Edgecombe (PHI) Questionable with an abdominal contusion, Kawhi Leonard (TOR) Out with knee swelling, and Anthony Black (ORL) Available. Murray is still Doubtful and Coward still Questionable.
document.footnote: Report checked at 6:30 PM ET. Lines as of about 6:30 PM ET. CourtAI's game logs and splits read the 2025-26 season; this season's facts are from the web research, with sources.

items.subtitle: ORL Out: Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain), Noah Penda, Jonathan Isaac, Izaiyah Nelson · Anthony Black Available (debut) · NYK Out: Jose Alvarado (ankle, new)
bullets: Usage 21.2% → 26.4%, 19.5 → 25.5 PTS/36 with Banchero off (986 min)
Usage 22.2% → 28.7%, 21.6 → 26.2 PTS/36 with Banchero off (570 min)
Starts in his place (10/10 last season), but scoring flat: 11.0 PTS in 26.7 MIN
body: Banchero started both games and averaged 41 and 26 minutes. He leaves 16 FGA and a 28% usage rate. Last season, with him on the bench, Bane's usage rose from 21.2% to 26.4% and Franz Wagner's from 22.2% to 28.7%. Franz played all 10 games Banchero missed, so that split already includes the two of them together. Tristan da Silva is projected to start in Banchero's place, as he did last season.

Black has missed every game, so Orlando has played without him from the start. If he returns, he takes some of the guard creation back. Penda and Isaac are long absences. Alvarado is a backup who played 16 and 11 minutes, and nothing moves for New York if he sits.

New since 4:30: Anthony Black is cleared to make his season debut, off the bench (Orlando's confirmed five is Suggs, Richardson, Bane, Wagner and Carter). Jose Alvarado is out for New York; McBride, Shamet and Clarkson take his backup minutes, and none had a split worth a spot (Alvarado missed 3 games last season). DraftKings cut Bane to 18.5 and Franz to 21.5, and the spread fell to NYK −6.5.
sources: da Silva projected to start; NYK −7.5

items.title: Desmond Bane o18.5 PTS
items.key: DraftKings cut him from 19.5 to 18.5; 23.1 PTS without Banchero, over 18.5 in 6/10; 25.5 PTS/36 with Banchero off
items.subtitle: DraftKings −125 / −102 · ORL @ NYK (NYK −6.5) · with Paolo Banchero out
body: New since 4:30: DraftKings cut the line a point, to 18.5 at −125, so the over now needs a game below his season average (20.1, over 18.5 in 44 of 82). Without Banchero last season he averaged 23.1 in 35.5 minutes and went over 18.5 in 6 of 10, though only 2 of the last 5.

Thesis: every book has Bane at 19.5, which is his scoring average with Banchero playing (20.1 over 82 games last season). Banchero's 16 FGA a night are gone for weeks, and last season Bane was the one who took them.

Usage: with Banchero on the bench last season (986 minutes), Bane's usage rose from 21.2% to 26.4%, his FGA from 14.4 to 18.2 per 36, and his scoring from 19.5 to 25.5 per 36. In the 10 full games Banchero missed he played 35.5 minutes and averaged 23.1 PTS on 17 FGA. Franz Wagner played all 10 of those games, so the split already counts the two of them sharing the ball.

Record: over 19.5 in 5 of 10 without Banchero. The median was 21, and two 37-point nights pull the average up. At 25.5 per 36 he needs about 28 minutes, and he played 29 or more in all 10. This season he has 18 in 33 minutes and 5 in 27 minutes of a blowout loss.
Matchup works against him: New York grades −5% vs league on points against his diet.
items.watch: Anthony Black returning (questionable) takes some of the guard creation back. New York is a 7.5-point favorite, so a blowout would cut his minutes. The record is a coin flip at this number; the case rests on the usage.
sources: Bane 18 and 5 PTS in the first two games

items.title: Ace Bailey o11.5 PTS
items.key: Over 11.5 in 28/34 without Nurkic last season, but on a tanking team; 12 and 6 PTS in 24 and 22 MIN this season
items.subtitle: DraftKings −108 / −118 · LAL @ UTA · with Jusuf Nurkic out
body: The split looks huge: 17.0 PTS in 30.7 minutes without Nurkic last season, over in 28 of 34. But those were mostly end-of-season games on a tanking team, with Markkanen and George often sitting. This season Utah added rookie Darryn Peterson, moved Jaren Jackson Jr. to center, and has Markkanen and George healthy. Bailey has played 24 and 22 minutes for 12 and 6 points. Nurkic hasn't played all season, so tonight changes nothing. The 11.5 reflects this season's role, not last season's.
items.watch: Nothing to watch; read last season's tank minutes as noise.
